'''Jewl'a Nightbringer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] born during the [[Great Galactic War]] and in operation during the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was the most feared hunter in her day. Nightbringer was known to be ruthless, with a rigorous belief in doling out retribution to those who crossed her.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Born during [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-wide conflict of the [[Great Galactic War]], Jewl'a Nightbringer grew up in the lower levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. She was raised in a life of poverty and violence, and was surrounded by regular food riots and looting due to the effects of the Mandalorian [[blockade of the Hydian Way]]. Orphaned as a teenager, Nightbringer was forced to rely on her ruthless nature as a natural-born fighter&mdash;becoming a predator rather than becoming the victim of one.<ref name="Holonet" />

===Life as a bounty hunter===
Nightbringer spent years honing her [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunting skills, while also enacting harsh retribution on anyone who crossed her. Once she had earned enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], she expanded her hunts off of the Republic capital and her reputation spread across the galaxy. As she continued collecting bounties, she was cited thirty-two times by local authorities for excessive force, wanted by authorities in seven [[Star system/Legends|systems]], and her license to operate had been revoked in Republic space.<ref name="Holonet" />

At some point in her career, Nightbringer was sponsored for the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] by an [[Exchange]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who had seen her in action, and survived being on her list of targets for a brief time. Her victory was noteworthy for the cruelty in which she operated, boasting no live captures. At the victory celebration, she openly showed her contempt of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] she had bested in the contest. She flaunted her victory over them in spite of challenges for [[honor duel]]s numbering in the hundreds. This event catalyzed her infamous reputation throughout the known galaxy, earning her respect in the eyes of the Mandalorians and fear from the denizens of the galactic underworld.<ref name="Holonet" />

Later, she was [[Grand Champions massacre|killed]] along with several other Great Hunt Champions by a Republic strike team assembled by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]].<ref name="TOR:Notorious" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:JewlaNightbringer-Holonet.png|thumb|right|150px|Jewl'a Nightbringer]]
Jewl'a Nightbringer was a vengeful individual and a born fighter. Growing up in the violent ways of street life forced her to develop such traits. She was known to be cruel and hold grudges, much to the peril of those who wronged her. She held Mandalorians in great contempt, as they were partially responsible for the harsh conditions in which she was raised. However, her fearlessness in the face of hundreds of honor challenges after the Great Hunt earned her the respect of the Mandalorians she so despised. Her ruthlessness and fearsome success record caused her to be the most feared bounty hunter of her day.<ref name="Holonet" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jewl'a Nightbringer was first mentioned in a [[The Holonet]] entry on the official ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' website. Her entry has several phrases written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] which read "Blacklist Veteran," "Ice Queen" and "Ultimate Sore Loser."<ref name="Holonet" />
